paper_title: First Constraints on the Photon Coupling of Axion-like Particles from Multimessenger Studies of the Neutron Star Merger GW170817
notes: Paper derives new 95% CL exclusion in (m_a, g_agamma) plane using Fermi-LAT observations of GW170817. The exclusion region is a 2D area (Fig 4) that I could not extract precisely; only benchmark points are numerically stated in text: Benchmark 1 (m_a=398 MeV, g=5.01e-11 GeV^-1) and Benchmark 2 (m_a=200 MeV, g=1.41e-12 GeV^-1), both stated to be currently unconstrained (inside future sensitivity, not the exclusion). The exact boundary of the purple excluded region spans roughly m_a ~ 0.1 MeV to ~1 GeV and g ~ 1e-12 to 1e-7 GeV^-1, but no tabulated boundary values are given. Data points listed are approximate/illustrative and low confidence; benchmarks are NOT excluded points. This is a stellar/merger astrophysical bound (not a haloscope), so no DM density assumed. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.4, 5))
